Questions owners actually ask

What happens during the free inspection?

A visit to your building, an on-site look at the roof, and a plain-terms explanation of what it needs — followed by a free estimate. Pricing is confirmed by phone after the inspection.

We had storm damage. What should I do first?

If water is coming in, call (832) 352-7997 — 24-hour emergency service is available. Otherwise, book the free on-site inspection so storm damage is found and documented on the roof itself, not guessed at from the ground.

Coating or replacement — how do I know which one?

That is what the inspection answers. A Mule-Hide coating can extend the life and energy efficiency of an existing roof and is often the alternative to a full tear-off — but only an on-site inspection can say whether your roof is a coating candidate or needs replacement.

Flat roof or metal roof — what is the difference in upkeep?

Flat roofs are built, repaired, and maintained as complete systems, where drainage and seams matter most. Metal roofs — galvanized and R-panel in 24 or 26 gauge — are long-lasting systems where panel condition and fasteners matter most. The selector above shows what each inspection checks.

How is pricing handled?

Pricing is confirmed by phone after the free inspection and free estimate, so the figure reflects your actual roof rather than a generic rate.

What areas do you serve?

The Greater Houston area, including Houston, Spring, The Woodlands, Cypress, and Katy. Call to confirm coverage for your building.
